name: Kaal Soulreaper
summary: In the Undercity, Kaal Soulreaper trains orc warlocks and keeps ties with dark practitioners across the Horde. Among the Forsaken, he guides students to mentors in distant lands.

sections.title: A Practitioner in the Shadows
sections.body:
Kaal Soulreaper teaches in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, where Horde warlocks seek his knowledge of demons and curses. Thrall's Horde keeps close watch on fel magic in Orgrimmar, so Lordaeron's underground sanctums give practitioners like Kaal room to work.

He also connects those who seek greater power with mentors across the sea. One of them is Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

faq.answer: Kaal Soulreaper trains warlocks in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He teaches spells and directs practitioners seeking specialized dark artifacts and rituals.

faq.q: Why is an orc warlock living in the Undercity?
aliases: why is an orc in undercity
faq.answer: Orcish society views warlocks with suspicion under Warchief Thrall. In the Undercity, Kaal can study shadow magic and demonology alongside the Forsaken, who are more tolerant.

faq.q: Where does Kaal Soulreaper send his apprentices?
aliases: who does kaal send you to
faq.answer: Kaal sends his students across the Great Sea to study under Menara Voidrender in the Barrens once they have mastered enough. He also introduces them to other prominent Horde warlocks.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can learn demonic arts from Kaal Soulreaper. His training sets ambitious warlocks on the path to crafting the Orb of Orahil and binding a Felsteed.
As an orc, you can find Kaal Soulreaper working openly in the Forsaken capital. He is away from Orgrimmar's watchful shamanic leadership and the hidden coven in the Cleft of Shadow.
